chunks: Muhammad b. Musa b. al-Mutawakkil (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Abdullah b. Ja'far al-Himyari and Sa'd b. Abdullah narrated to us from Imran b. Musa from al-Hasan b. Ali b. al-Nu'man from Muhammad b. Fudayl from Ghazwan al-Dabbi. He said: Abd al-Rahman b. Ishaq informed me from al-Nu'man b. Sa'd from Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him). He said:

I am the Proof of Allah, the Caliph of Allah, the Path of Allah, the Gate of Allah, the Treasurer of Allah's Knowledge, the Keeper of Allah's Secret, and the Imam of creation after the best of creation, Muhammad, the Prophet of Mercy (may Allah bless him and his family).

key_terms.إمام البرية: Imam of creation — the leader and guide of all created beings
key_terms.المؤتمن على سر الله: The Entrusted One with Allah's Secret — the one entrusted with divine mysteries
key_terms.باب الله: Gate of Allah — the doorway through which access to divine knowledge and grace is obtained
key_terms.حجة الله: Proof of Allah — the divine evidence and authority established by God over His creation
key_terms.خازن علم الله: Treasurer of Allah's Knowledge — the guardian and custodian of divine knowledge
key_terms.خليفة الله: Caliph of Allah — the divinely appointed vicegerent and successor of God on earth
key_terms.صراط الله: Path of Allah — the straight path leading to God, embodied in the Imam

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about his divinely appointed titles and station?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) declares his divinely appointed station, stating that he is the Proof of Allah, the Caliph of Allah, the Path of Allah, the Gate of Allah, the Treasurer of Allah's Knowledge, the Keeper of Allah's Secret, and the Imam of creation after the greatest of creation, Muhammad, the Prophet of Mercy (peace be upon him and his family).
word_analysis: may Allah have mercy on him
